 Written by Ritesh Presswala , ETMarkets.com | Nov 06, 2026, 03:35:02 PM IST 1 / 13 Midcap masters
 The broader market rally has been particularly strong in the midcap segment in FY27 so far. While the benchmark Nifty50 has gained around 10%, the Nifty Midcap 150 index has outperformed with a nearly 15% rise. The rally has also translated into sharp gains for several individual stocks, with around 42 midcap stocks advancing more than 25% during this period.
Among these, we highlight 12 stocks that have delivered impressive returns, surging between 50% and 136% so far in FY27. (Data Source: ACE Equity)
